# Design DNA in Claude Code

<!-- generated by python install.py docs from hosts/registry/claude-code.json -->

## Install

### CLI, desktop Code tab, IDE extensions: skill folder

Method: skill folder. Capability: **Local agent with a shell**. Runs the engine on your machine. Everything works once the Python packages and a Chromium browser are installed; python install.py doctor checks both.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/OzyAcc/design-dna && cd design-dna
python install.py install --target claude-code            # user scope: ~/.claude/skills/reverse-design
python install.py install --target claude-code --scope project --project <your project>   # .claude/skills/reverse-design
```

Add `--dry-run` to see the changes first. The installer also runs `pip install -r requirements.txt` (skip with `--no-deps`). Without the installer, unzip [design-dna-skill.zip](https://github.com/OzyAcc/design-dna/releases/latest/download/design-dna-skill.zip) into `~/.claude/skills/`.

### Plugin from this repository's marketplace

Method: plugin / extension. Capability: **Local agent with a shell**. Runs the engine on your machine. Everything works once the Python packages and a Chromium browser are installed; python install.py doctor checks both.

1. claude plugin marketplace add OzyAcc/design-dna
2. claude plugin install design-dna@design-dna
3. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt (once, for the engine)

## Where the host looks

| Scope | Folders this host reads (from its documentation) |
|---|---|
| user | `~/.claude/skills` |
| project | `.claude/skills` |

If two of these folders hold `reverse-design`, the host picks one by its own precedence rules. `python install.py doctor --target claude-code` lists every copy it can see.

## Prerequisites

- Claude Code
- Python 3.10+ and Chromium for the engine

## Check, update, remove

```bash
python install.py doctor --target claude-code      # Python, packages, Chromium, store, visible copies
python install.py update --target claude-code      # refresh from this checkout (git pull first)
python install.py uninstall --target claude-code   # only unmodified copies it installed; templates are kept
```

## Try it

Attach a poster or social post and ask: *Scan this design with Design DNA and save it as "Spring Launch".* Then: *Change only the headline to "Made for every day" and keep everything else.*
